title: Read verified Git Hub source
responsibility: Build a source adapter with immutable commit caches, blob integrity checks, LFS materialization and history queries.

inputs.name: createGitHubSource.options
inputs.description: Options configures GitHub requests for this source, and the factory combines it with a repository identity before creating a read transport. The repository identity is supplied separately by adapter methods.

outputs.name: createGitHubSource
outputs.description: A per-request adapter for resolving commits, listing trees, reading raw or LFS-materialized bytes, validating anchors, and querying Git history. It memoizes commit, tree, blob, and materialized reads, returns copied objects and byte arrays, and evicts failed memoized reads.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: This error marks explicit source validation failures: commit mismatch, truncated or mismatched tree, unsafe or duplicate paths, missing or non-regular files, and blob integrity failure. Rejections from delegated transport, anchor, history, or LFS helpers follow those implementations.
